# What was The Weeknd?
## Abel Tesfaye's alter-ego meets his end on 'Hurry Up Tomorrow,' forcing listeners to ask just who we've been partying with all this time
![Hurry Up Tomorrow is Abel Tesfaye's sixth studio album as The Weekend — and, he's declared, his last under that identity.](https://npr.brightspotcdn.com/dims3/default/strip/false/crop/5504x5504+0+688/resize/1100/quality/50/format/jpeg/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fnpr-brightspot.s3.amazonaws.com%2F8d%2Ff8%2F0e55cc1d4b2fad2179fa1bbfbc4b%2Fgeneral-press-tw-press-s1-press-137.jpg)

_Hurry Up Tomorrow_ is Abel Tesfaye's sixth studio album as The Weekend — and, he's declared, his last under that identity.

# _Hurry Up Tomorrow_
_**Hurry Up Tomorrow**_ is the sixth studio album by Canadian singer [The Weeknd](https://the-weeknd.fandom.com/wiki/The_Weeknd).

The record is the third in the new trilogy (previous chapters being [_After Hours_](https://the-weeknd.fandom.com/wiki/After_Hours_(album)) and [_Dawn FM_](https://the-weeknd.fandom.com/wiki/Dawn_FM_(album))), and serves as the final studio album under "The Weeknd" name/persona (it is currently unspecified which).
